evidence_notes: JLCPCB live detail page verified 2026-09-27: C1042; Sunlord; full MPN SDFL2012Q1R0KTF; 0805; badge Extended; 1uH; ±10%; Q 45 at 10MHz; self-resonant frequency 75MHz; 400mΩ DCR; 50mA rated current.
The JLC page shows stock 38,843, minimum purchase quantity 1, full reel 4,000, available order quantity 29,293, SMT Assembly, and Economic and Standard PCBA types. No assembly minimum was displayed.
The LCSC product page https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C1042.html was opened in the browser and returned Part not found; it did not provide an identity cross-check or datasheet.

The PDF was downloaded by opening the actual datasheet link on the JLC product page. The six-page document is the Sunlord SDFL Series multilayer chip ferrite inductor datasheet. Page 1's ordering-code key defines 2012 as 0805, 1R0 as 1.0uH, K as ±10%, and shows the two-terminal chip form. Page 3's SDFL2012 Q1R0 row confirms 1.0uH, Q=45 at 10MHz, SRF=75MHz, DCR=0.4Ω, and rated current=50mA.
